6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorClassMeromorphic
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.MulEquiv
8	import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.SectionSpaces
9	
10	/-!
11	# DAT-C C3 — effective uniqueness at `h⁰ = 1`
12	(`informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` GAP-2, Σ-UNIQ-fld)
13	
14	The field-level uniqueness brick of the canonical-section normalization: on the curve
15	bundle `X` over a field `K`, an effective divisor `D` with `h⁰(𝒪(D)) = 1` is the
16	**unique** effective representative of its Čech Picard class.
17	
18	Route (worksheet §0.3 GAP-2, verbatim): equal classes give a rational function `g`
19	with `div g = D' − D` (`CurveDivisor.exists_divOf_of_picClass_eq`); `g ∈ H⁰(𝒪(D))`
20	since `div g + D = D' ≥ 0` (`mem_divisorSections_top_iff`); `1 ∈ H⁰(𝒪(D))` since
21	`0 ≤ D`; `h⁰ = 1` forces `g = c · 1` (`finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero'` through the
22	`h⁰` bridge `finrank_divisorSections_top`), and a nonzero constant has trivial
23	principal divisor, so `D' − D = div g = 0`.
24	
25	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ord_functionFieldOverAlgebraMap_eq_one` — a nonzero
26	  constant has trivial order valuation at every closed point.
27	* `Scheme.divOf_eq_zero_of_val_eq_functionFieldOverAlgebraMap` — a unit of `K(X)`
28	  whose value is a constant has trivial principal divisor.
29	* `Scheme.one_mem_divisorSections_top` — `1 ∈ H⁰(𝒪(D))` for effective `D`.
30	* `Scheme.CurveDivisor.eq_of_picClass_eq_of_finrank_one` — the worker, with the
31	  section-space hypothesis `dim_K H⁰(𝒪(D)) = 1`.
32	* `Scheme.CurveDivisor.eq_of_picClass_eq_of_h0_one` — **the keystone**: `0 ≤ D`,
33	  `0 ≤ D'`, equal classes, `h⁰(𝒪(D)) = 1` imply `D' = D`.
34	-/
35	
36	set_option autoImplicit false
37	
38	universe u
39	
40	open CategoryTheory Opposite
41	
42	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
43	
44	attribute [local instance] Scheme.functionFieldOverModule Scheme.overModule
45	
46	namespace Scheme
47	
48	variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
49	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
50	
51	/-! ## Constants have trivial order and trivial principal divisor -/
52	
53	/-- **A nonzero constant has trivial order valuation at every closed point**: both `c`
54	and `c⁻¹` are integral (`ord ≤ 1`), and their orders multiply to `ord 1 = 1`. -/
55	theorem ord_functionFieldOverAlgebraMap_eq_one {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X)
56	    {c : K} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
57	    Scheme.ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx (functionFieldOverAlgebraMap K X c)
58	      = 1 := by
59	  have ha := ord_functionFieldOverAlgebraMap_le_one K hx c
60	  have hb := ord_functionFieldOverAlgebraMap_le_one K hx c⁻¹
61	  have hmul : Scheme.ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx
62	        (functionFieldOverAlgebraMap K X c)
63	      * Scheme.ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx
64	        (functionFieldOverAlgebraMap K X c⁻¹) = 1 := by
65	    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, map_one, map_one]
66	  refine le_antisymm ha ?_
67	  calc (1 : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))
68	      = Scheme.ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx
69	          (functionFieldOverAlgebraMap K X c)
70	        * Scheme.ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx
71	          (functionFieldOverAlgebraMap K X c⁻¹) := hmul.symm
72	    _ ≤ Scheme.ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx
73	          (functionFieldOverAlgebraMap K X c) * 1 := mul_le_mul_right hb _
74	    _ = Scheme.ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx
75	          (functionFieldOverAlgebraMap K X c) := mul_one _
76	
77	variable [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
78	  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
79	
80	/-- **A constant unit has trivial principal divisor**: `div (c · 1) = 0`. -/
81	theorem divOf_eq_zero_of_val_eq_functionFieldOverAlgebraMap {g : X.functionFieldˣ}
82	    {c : K} (hval : (g : X.functionField) = functionFieldOverAlgebraMap K X c) :
83	    Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) g = 0 := by
84	  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
85	    rintro rfl
86	    exact g.ne_zero (by rw [hval, map_zero])
87	  refine CurveDivisor.ext_coeffAt fun x hx => ?_
88	  rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_divOf, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero]
89	  have hord : Scheme.ordZ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx g = 1 := by
90	    rw [Scheme.ordZ_eq_one_iff, hval]
91	    exact ord_functionFieldOverAlgebraMap_eq_one K hx hc
92	  rw [hord, toAdd_one]
93	
94	/-! ## The two members of `H⁰(𝒪(D))` -/
95	
96	/-- **The constant `1` is a global section of `𝒪(D)` for effective `D`.** -/
97	theorem one_mem_divisorSections_top {D : X.CurveDivisor} (hD : 0 ≤ D) :
98	    (1 : X.functionField) ∈ divisorSections K D ⊤ := by
99	  rw [mem_divisorSections_top_iff K one_ne_zero]
100	  have hone : Units.mk0 (1 : X.functionField) one_ne_zero = 1 := Units.ext rfl
101	  rw [hone, Scheme.divOf_one, add_zero]
102	  exact hD
103	
104	/-! ## Effective uniqueness -/
105	
106	/-- **Effective uniqueness at `dim H⁰ = 1` (worker form)**: if `0 ≤ D`, `0 ≤ D'`, the
107	classes agree, and the global sections of `𝒪(D)` are one-dimensional, then `D' = D`.
108	The extracted function realizing `D' − D` lies in `H⁰(𝒪(D))`, hence is a constant
109	multiple of `1 ∈ H⁰(𝒪(D))`, hence has trivial divisor. -/
110	theorem CurveDivisor.eq_of_picClass_eq_of_finrank_one {D D' : X.CurveDivisor}
111	    (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hD' : 0 ≤ D')
112	    (hcl : CurveDivisor.picClass K D = CurveDivisor.picClass K D')
113	    (hone : Module.finrank K ↥(divisorSections K D ⊤) = 1) :
114	    D' = D := by
115	  -- the rational function with divisor `D' − D`
116	  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := CurveDivisor.exists_divOf_of_picClass_eq K hcl.symm
117	  -- `g ∈ H⁰(𝒪(D))`: `div g + D = D' ≥ 0`
118	  have hmem : (g : X.functionField) ∈ divisorSections K D ⊤ := by
119	    rw [mem_divisorSections_top_iff K g.ne_zero]
120	    have hmk : Units.mk0 (g : X.functionField) g.ne_zero = g := Units.ext rfl
121	    rw [hmk, ← hg, add_sub_cancel]
122	    exact hD'
123	  -- `h⁰ = 1` forces `g = c · 1`
124	  have h1mem : (1 : X.functionField) ∈ divisorSections K D ⊤ :=
125	    one_mem_divisorSections_top K hD
126	  have h1ne : (⟨1, h1mem⟩ : ↥(divisorSections K D ⊤)) ≠ 0 := by
127	    intro h
128	    exact one_ne_zero (congrArg Subtype.val h)
129	  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' (⟨1, h1mem⟩ :
130	    ↥(divisorSections K D ⊤)) h1ne).mp hone ⟨(g : X.functionField), hmem⟩
131	  have hval : (g : X.functionField) = functionFieldOverAlgebraMap K X c := by
132	    have h : c • (1 : X.functionField) = (g : X.functionField) :=
133	      congrArg Subtype.val hc
134	    rw [← h, functionFieldOverModule_smul_def, mul_one]
135	  -- the constant has trivial divisor, so `D' − D = 0`
136	  have hdiv0 : Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) g = 0 :=
137	    divOf_eq_zero_of_val_eq_functionFieldOverAlgebraMap K hval
138	  rw [hdiv0] at hg
139	  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hg
140	
141	/-- **Effective uniqueness at `h⁰ = 1`** (worksheet GAP-2, Σ-UNIQ-fld — THE keystone):
142	an effective divisor `D` with `h⁰(𝒪(D)) = 1` is the unique effective representative of
143	its Čech Picard class. -/
144	theorem CurveDivisor.eq_of_picClass_eq_of_h0_one {D D' : X.CurveDivisor}
145	    (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hD' : 0 ≤ D')
146	    (hcl : CurveDivisor.picClass K D = CurveDivisor.picClass K D')
147	    (hone : Sheaf.h0 (X.divisorSheaf K D) = 1) :
148	    D' = D :=
149	  CurveDivisor.eq_of_picClass_eq_of_finrank_one K hD hD' hcl
150	    ((finrank_divisorSections_top K D).trans hone)
151	
152	end Scheme
153	
154	end AlgebraicGeometry
